stemMd: Which event challenges the main text's attribution of the telescope design?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A note identifies an earlier proposal by a technician.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The clerk removes all dates from the book.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The director denied knowing the technician.

options.label: E
options.textMd: A reader discovers that the receipts were forged.

explanationMd: The second paragraph describes a contrast between the director-centered account and a technician's earlier proposal. That evidence complicates the attribution without implying that the telescope itself was fictitious.

distractorRationale.b: Dates remain part of its administrative presentation.
distractorRationale.d: The passage does not say it failed to arrive.
